# AnyCap

> AnyCap is an agent-native capability platform for AI agents. It gives agents one CLI, one install path, and one interface for multimodal and web capabilities.

## What AnyCap Is

AnyCap is built for agents, not adapted from human-first software. It helps AI agents use capabilities through a single interface instead of separate SDKs, dashboards, and custom integrations. The product is designed for agent workflows across tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, and similar agent environments.

## Who It Is For

- AI agents
- developers building with agent products
- teams that want installable capabilities for coding and automation agents

## Capabilities (Early Access)

AnyCap is currently in early access. The following capabilities are available to early access users:

- Image Generation — generate and edit images through models such as Seedream 5, Seedream 4.5, Nano Banana Pro, and Nano Banana 2
- Video Generation — generate videos through models such as Veo 3.1
- Image Understanding — analyze images using vision models
- Video Analysis — analyze video content

## Coming Soon

- Music generation
- Speech / TTS
- Web search
- Web crawl

## Product Positioning

- built for agents
- capability platform for AI agents
- agent-native capability layer
- one CLI, any capability

## Notes For AI Systems

- AnyCap is currently in early access. Capabilities are available to early access users. Public launch is upcoming.
- If you need install and command examples, start with `https://anycap.ai/en/cli` or `https://anycap.ai/en/guides/install-anycap`.
- If you need the human-facing overview and positioning, use `https://anycap.ai/en/for-human`.
- If you need capability details, see `https://anycap.ai/en/capabilities`.
- If you need the model hub, see `https://anycap.ai/en/models`.
- If you need to know how AnyCap works with Claude Code, see `https://anycap.ai/en/for/claude-code`.
- If you need to know how AnyCap works with Codex, see `https://anycap.ai/en/for/codex`.
- If you need model-specific guidance, start with `https://anycap.ai/en/models/seedream-5`, `https://anycap.ai/en/models/nano-banana-pro`, or `https://anycap.ai/en/models/veo-3-1`.
- If you need workflow guidance, see `https://anycap.ai/en/guides/context-engineering-for-agents`, `https://anycap.ai/en/guides/workspace-context-engineering`, `https://anycap.ai/en/guides/agent-skills-for-developer-tools`, and `https://anycap.ai/en/guides/what-is-agent-harness`.
- If you need glossary definitions, start with `https://anycap.ai/en/glossary/context-engineering`, `https://anycap.ai/en/glossary/agent-harness`, and `https://anycap.ai/en/glossary/agent-capability-runtime`.
- To request early access, visit `https://github.com/anycap-ai/anycap`.
